queries.title: Failed sign-ins by user (last 24h)
queries.description: Counts failed interactive sign-ins per user over the last day. Result type 0 is success, everything else is a failure code.
queries.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Failures = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, ResultType
| order by Failures desc
| take 20

queries.title: Machines that stopped sending heartbeats
queries.description: Lists computers whose last heartbeat is older than 30 minutes. Useful for spotting agents that are offline or broken.
queries.query:
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, OSType
| where LastHeartbeat < ago(30m)
| extend MinutesSilent = datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastHeartbeat)
| order by MinutesSilent desc

queries.title: Windows 4625 logon failures by source IP
queries.description: Groups failed logons (event 4625) by source address. Works, but IpAddress is often '-' for local logons, so those get lumped together and should be filtered out.
queries.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4625
| summarize Attempts = count(), Accounts = dcount(TargetUserName) by IpAddress, Computer
| where Attempts > 10
| order by Attempts desc

queries.title: PowerShell with encoded commands
queries.description: Finds PowerShell launches that use -EncodedCommand (or shortened forms) in the last 7 days and decodes the payload for review.
queries.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "-EncodedCommand", "-e ")
| extend Encoded = extract(@"-[eE][nN]?[cC]?[a-zA-Z]*\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = base64_decode_tostring(Encoded)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Decoded, ProcessCommandLine

queries.title: CPU utilization trend per computer
queries.description: Average processor time in 15-minute bins for the last 6 hours, rendered as a time chart.
queries.query:
Perf
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize AvgCpu = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Computer
| render timechart

queries.title: Azure resource deletions by caller
queries.description: Intended to list who deleted which resources. Currently returns nothing in my workspace, probably because the schema uses OperationNameValue rather than OperationName in newer tables. Needs fixing.
queries.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OperationName endswith "delete"
| where ActivityStatus == "Succeeded"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceGroup, Resource, OperationName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
